text: This Steam demo is sixteen point nine gigabytes. Three people made it.
Seven hundred and seventy megabytes of that download is a file they forgot to delete.
Debug symbols. They're how you read a crash report. They belong on a build server, not on your players' drives.
The rest is real content, to be fair. One scene, and fifteen hundred streaming bundles behind it.
Every weapon is separate parts with their own stats, so the art multiplies fast.
Though a single two gigabyte bundle usually means textures nobody set the compression on.
And the store page still says you need eight gigabytes of storage.
If you ship this year, strip your symbols. It's one checkbox. Full teardown on the channel.
